title: DNS Takeover
description:
Join us for a massive joint birthday takeover! 🥳

We're pulling out all the stops to celebrate the special days of our favorites, KYTRA and ED HOFFMAN. This is a celebration you won't want to miss!

Get ready for an epic night of DIRTY HOUSE MUSIC and so much more, spinning all night long. We've got a killer lineup of talent ready to bring the heat.

The best part? It's FREE to attend all night. No cover, just pure vibes.

Tell a friend to tell a friend! Let's make this a birthday bash to remember.
